# Docusign

> > Docusign provides cloud-based electronic signature and agreement management solutions, including eSignature, CLM (Contract Lifecycle Management), and AI-powered tools for automating and streamlining business agreements.

Docusign Agreement Cloud is a comprehensive platform that combines electronic signature capabilities with contract lifecycle management, AI-assisted review, and workflow automation. The platform offers REST APIs for developers, integrations with Salesforce and Microsoft tools, and compliance features including CFR Part 11 and GDPR support.

## Key Topics

- Docusign eSignature
- Docusign CLM (Contract Lifecycle Management)
- Docusign Agreement Cloud
- eSignature REST API
- AI-Assisted Review and Agreement Summaries
- Contract automation and workflow automation
- Embedded signing
- Agreement management
- Docusign Navigator
- Docusign Gen
- CFR Part 11 compliance
- Salesforce integration and Apex Toolkit
- Small business solutions
- Identity verification (IDNow)
- API development (Python, C#, Postman)
